data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel that has raised $67M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of three same-stage, same-sector private comparables—Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B)—along with one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and a broader set of eight private frontier-tech peers including Figure AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $67M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression, yielding $127M. Peer-median analysis calculates the median valuation across the three same-stage, same-sector comparables at $3.2B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $5.6B. The wide range reflects material valuation variance within the Series B frontier-tech cohort.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $108M (low) to $3.7B (high), with a median of $1.7B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median outputs reflects the high sensitivity of early-stage AI valuations to market sentiment and heterogeneity in capital efficiency across the cohort. Key uncertainties include Sift Stack's specific revenue traction, customer concentration, and competitive positioning relative to the named peers.
